proofBoundary: Machine-verified experimental options; runtime, player-surface, semantic, save/load, and support proof remain separate.

options.name: Above All Else
options.description: Meet a vampiric Khajiit who claims he can see the ancient dead. Join him in this quest to "become above all else".

options.name: Aetherium Forge Destroys Items
options.description: This mod allows you to destroy items by dropping them in the lava at the Aetherium Forge.

options.name: Baba Yaga and the Labyrinth
options.description: Fully voiced quest to discover the mysteries of a walking hut, a soul cairn maze, weeping angels, and a witch.

options.name: Bards Reborn - Student of Song
options.description: This mod gives the Bards College a massive makeover, adds a new study quest, new bardic powers, and new characters to flesh out your experience as a student in the Bards College.

options.name: Bark and Bite
options.description: Uncover the origins of a mysterious tree within the Rift and choose if you wish to meddle in such affairs.

options.name: Become a Bard
options.description: Tired of being a warrior or mage? Become a Bard!

options.name: Before the End
options.description: Speak with a prisoner awaiting execution and learn all about his life's biggest regrets.

options.name: Beyond Skyrim - Bruma
options.description: Travel beyond the borders of Skyrim and explore Bruma, the northernmost county in Cyrodiil. Delve into Ayleid ruins, meddle in local affairs or explore the wilds - the journey begins now.

options.name: Calling the Watchmaker
options.description: Calling the Watchmaker is a quest mod featuring high quality voice acting and an extremely unique story that delves into the creation myth of the Elder Scrolls universe.

options.name: College of Winterhold - Quest Expansion
options.description: This mod provides 7 new starter magic lessons/quests to make your College of Winterhold feel like an actual school of magic.

options.name: Daedric Shrines AIO prayer activators
options.description: Statues of Daedric Lords.

options.name: Depths of the Soul
options.description: Depths of the Soul features a rather helpful merchant who will aid the player by selling various items for dungeons.

options.name: Forsworn Conspiracy - Quest Expansion
options.description: Greatly expanded the Forsworn Conspiracy questline to give new choices, new roleplaying opportunities, new epic stories. Over 200 new lines.

options.name: Hunt for the Spectre
options.description: The Hunt for the Spectre is an Elden Ring inspired quest mod centred around Ren, a man who is hunting a serial killer known as the Spectre. The mod features multiple endings and incredibly high quality voice acting.

options.name: Ill Met by Moonlight - Dialogue Expansion
options.description: Defy the will of Hircine while still serving justice to Sinding. A fully voiced mini-expansion of the namesake quest using voice actors or spliced lines.

options.name: Infiltration - Quest Expansion
options.description: One of the most underwhelming vanilla quests... turned into an epic quest full of player choice.

options.name: Legacy of the Dragonborn
options.description: Not just a display mod, not just a quest mod, not just a new guild mod, but a complete foundational flagship mod to build an entire load order around. This DLC expansion sized mod adds hundreds of new items, dozens of new quests and hundreds of extra hours of play.

options.name: M'rissi's Tails of Troubles
options.description: Fully immersive and lore-friendly story with 8 hours of quests, more than 2000 voiced lines and 3 different endings. Choose your path and decide her fate.

options.name: Moon and Star
options.description: A mysterious and powerful criminal has been spotted in Skyrim, his trail dogged by hunters from Morrowind. However, there may be more at stake than it seems, and this criminal may be familiar...

options.name: Moonpath to Elsweyr
options.description: Brought to you by An_Old_Sock, the author of the in-development Moonpath Reborn, Moonpath to Elsweyr is enjoying regular updates for the first time in five years. This is the most comprehensive Moonpath experience to date.

options.name: Nilheim - Misc Quest Expansion
options.description: Fixes some issues with the misc quest at Nilheim and gives a bit more flexibility to your encounter with good old Telrav, adding a couple of additional dialogue choices and options for roleplaying.

options.name: Olenveld
options.description: Olenveld is a new lands mod, the size of a small DLC, bringing the lore-rich location of Olenveld to Skyrim. It introduces a unique questline and an island recapturing system.

options.name: Once We Were Here
options.description: Once We Were Here is a short to medium sized quest mod that revolves around Sillas, a Bosmer scholar investigating the Falmer.
options.dependency: Once We Were Here - Quest Mod.esp

options.name: Paarthurnax - Quest Expansion
options.description: A fully voiced, quite expanded new take on the quest Paarthurnax, giving both the Blades and Paarthurnax good reasons for their stances, and you, Dragonborn, the final choice.

options.name: Project AHO
options.description: Project AHO is a large quest modification, comparable in size to a medium-sized DLC. Designed in the best traditions of Bethesda Game Studios, this mod adds to Skyrim a hidden settlement of Great House Telvanni. Determine its fate for yourself!

options.name: Save the Icerunner
options.description: Jaree-Ra in Solitude has a plan to set up a shipwreck. The ship is said to be full of weapons and riches, ripe for the taking. What will you do?

options.name: Siege at Icemoth
options.description: A small scale vanilla-esque new lands mod adding some new islands with new locations and dungeons in the Sea of Ghosts. As well as some unique items from The Elder Scrolls Blades.

options.name: Sirenroot
options.description: You and a team of divers are hired to scour ruins at the bottom of Lake Honrich. A dialogue-heavy quest with puzzles, platforming, and a focus on water mechanics.

options.name: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers
options.description: Return to the Shivering Isles in a fully-voiced overhaul of Skyrim's Saints and Seducers Creation.
options.dependency: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp

options.name: Song of the Green - Auri
options.description: A standalone, custom-voiced follower and quest mod.

options.name: Taste of Death Addon
options.description: Adds new dialogue, enemies, and gameplay to the vanilla quest "The Taste of Death". Confront the cult of Namira and bring them to justice.

options.name: The Forgotten City
options.description: A critically acclaimed expansion mod offering a unique 6 - 8 hour experience: a murder mystery investigation set in an ancient underground city. You'll need to solve it using your wits, and the ability to travel through time.

options.name: The Frozen Heart
options.description: Step through a magical mirror into a cursed frozen realm. Explore labyrinths, solve puzzles, ponder orbs, battle shadows, and help an ancient Snow Elf warrior cure her curse.

options.name: The Gift of Saturalia
options.description: A fully voiced new quest. Help the people of Skyrim and spread the spirit of Saturalia.

options.name: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
options.description: Will you be worthy for the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal? We'll see!

options.name: The Heart of Dibella - Quest Expansion
options.description: Tired of having to break into a ladies-only religious building just to start this quest? This mod has you covered with new roleplaying opportunities, more dialogue and more choices.
options.dependency: The Heart Of Dibella - Quest Expansion.esp

options.name: The Rot Below
options.description: Discover the secrets of a mad lich who thought themselves a god. Explore an ancient palace, a subterranean city of the undead, and an insane warlock's research hall. Foil Namira's plans and stop the coming rot.

options.name: The Sinister Seven
options.description: The Sinister Seven is a backstory quest line. Seven Assassins are dispatched to kill the player, taking place across several levels.

options.name: The Tools of Kagrenac
options.description: Go on a quest to recover the legendary Tools of Kagrenac. Encounter new allies and enemies, explore sprawling dungeons, and add powerful new artifacts and spells to your arsenal in this fully-voiced quest mod!

options.name: The Whispering Door - Quest Expansion
options.description: Experience a longer version of Mephala's Daedric quest, now with more dialogue, more decisions and a general darker approach to the original quest.

options.name: Thieves Guild Alternative Endings
options.description: Defy Nocturnal and unlock yourself from eternal servitude. Adds 4 new voice-acted endings to the Thieves Guild questline, including new story, new rewards, new boss fights.

options.name: Thogra
options.description: Help an Orc widow get revenge on the one who wronged her. The same Thogra gra-Mugur, now with a new voice!

options.name: Unslaad
options.description: Quest mod of Half-Dragon. Add fluffy equipment and creatures.

options.name: Vigilant
options.description: Vigilant of Stendarr Quest.

options.name: War's Folly
options.description: Stumble across Sandor, a zealous preacher who seeks to convince Solitude's residents that the Civil War is one of folly. Hear his sermons and converse with the man, perhaps even you will begin to question your ideals.

options.name: Whispers of the Depths
options.description: Whispers of the Depths centres around an Argonian fisherman, Slays-Many-Beasts. Through the four encounters of this mod, he will tell tales of his time at sea, and the various monsters he encountered.

options.name: Wyrmstooth
options.description: A large DLC-sized quest expansion for Skyrim featuring a new island to explore, fully voice acted NPCs, new dungeons, new music, and a player home.

options.name: Xelzaz
options.description: Xelzaz is a Custom Fully Voiced Argonian Lawman of House Telvanni with ~8500 lines. He has just arrived in Skyrim and is looking for a traveling companion. In return he will keep you company, cook you warm meals and brew powerful potions.
